---
title: "C++ Short Course (optional)"
---

All programming assignments in this course use C++. You'll set up your programming infrastructure and get a brief introduction to the language in your first lab, but if you'd like a more thorough, principled walkthrough of the language beforehand, this optional recorded tutorial series covers the parts of C++ this course actually uses — and the typical "gotchas" that trip people up. (Recommended playback speed: 1.5x.)

In this tutorial, we cover how C++ implements:

- Classes
- Pointers
- Arrays
- Parameter passing
- Return values
- Constructors (reprise)
- The Big 3
  - Memory management
  - Overloading operators
- Inheritance (not included)
- Templates (superficial)
- Generic programming (not included)
